messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: post-deploy routing oscillation detected for release r/2026-03-17-42. 95p latency x3, p99 tail up, ingest throughput down ~40%. Several nodes fell back to generic_kernel v2.1 -> increased token timeouts. See runbook: https://wiki.internal/release-runbooks#r2026-03-17-42 :rotating_light:

eric_oncall: ack. I'm on it. Reproducing locally then checking canary pool metrics.

sasha_eng: I'm looking at the rollout controller. Not seeing a crashloop, but healthchecks toggling. Could be routing flapping between slice A/B.

leo_sre: logs show repeated kernel-select fallback on gpu-node-12/17: 
```
[2026-03-17T21:03:12Z] kernel_selector: preferred kernel 'fast-attn' failed compile -> fallback to 'generic_kernel' (quant path)
[2026-03-17T21:03:12Z] runtime: kv-cache hit-rate drop 0.12 -> 0.03, batch-window shrink
[2026-03-17T21:03:15Z] rpc: request latency spike (tail) 820ms -> 2400ms
```

maria_platform: rolling back kernel affinity flag on the subset now. Can we flip the FF that rolled with this release? Which flag name?

sasha_eng: flag is ff.enable_kernel_prefer_fast_attn. It was enabled in wave 3. I can cut it to 0 for wave 3.

eric_oncall: do it. Prioritize customer-facing regions (us-east-1, eu-west-1). Also PUT rate-limit on new-release traffic slice to 10rps.

deploy-bot: Deploy event: r/2026-03-17-42 wave-3 partial -> rollback/flag-toggle requested by sasha_eng. Job 44321 started.

leo_sre: after flag flip on two nodes in us-east-1: p95 dropped from 900ms -> 260ms, throughput +18%. But a few nodes still showing fallback.

sasha_eng: pushing a hotfix to the routing controller to respect session-affinity for ongoing flows. Minor config: session_affinity_ttl=600s. Deploying to canary first.

julie_cs: FYI CS: some customers reporting degraded autocomplete latency in east/us. Not many support tickets yet, but flagged. Please update status page if this persists.

pm-lina: marking incident P1 due to customer-facing latency. Need customer impact summary and ETA for full mitigation.

eric_oncall: summarizing mitigation steps taken: 1) flipped ff.enable_kernel_prefer_fast_attn off for wave-3 2) applied rate-limit to new-release slice 3) rolled hotfix to routing controller canary (affinity TTL) 4) restarting kernel-selector on nodes with persistent fallback.

leo_sre: executing kernel-selector restart on gpu-node-17 and gpu-node-23 now.

maria_platform: restarting completed on those nodes. Observed immediate reconnects and kv-cache warmup. p99 improved but still elevated on a minority of sessions.

eric_oncall: good. Assign follow-ups: leo - finish node restarts and watch for regressions; sasha - monitor canary routing fix and promote if stable; maria - run postmortem template and collect histograms; julie - update customers with current status and note limited impact subset.

sasha_eng: canary looks stable after 12min. I'll promote to remaining waves in 5 minutes.

leo_sre: node restarts complete. No further kernel fallback logged for last 7m.

pm-lina: ETA to full mitigation?

eric_oncall: estimating 15–25 minutes for full roll-forward of routing fix and stabilization. Will update if anything changes.

julie_cs: posting initial customer note: "We detected a partial degradation impacting latency for newer release traffic. Our engineers have applied mitigations and expect full recovery within 30 minutes. We're monitoring closely."

deploy-bot: Job 44321: flag-toggle and canary promotion completed. All waves green except wave-5 (staggered).

eric_oncall: handing off to night oncall @leo_sre in 25 minutes. Current status: mitigations applied, majority of traffic stable, residual p99 tail on <2% sessions. Postmortem owner: maria_platform.

leo_sre: ack. I'll monitor overnight and escalate if p99 jumps or customer reports increase.

pm-lina: thanks team. Action items: postmortem within 48h, add extra observability to kernel-selector decisions, and add automated safety gate to fail release if kernel fallback rate > 1% during canary.

julie_cs: will follow up with customers who reported issues with a post-incident summary.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status -> mitigated, severity -> P1 (mitigated). Next update by eric_oncall or leo_sre. :white_check_mark:

eric_oncall: final note before handoff: no data exfil or errors other than latency. No rollback needed. Closing urgent mitigation window. Handoff to @leo_sre.

leo_sre: taking over. Good job everyone.
